title: Draw a Sample of Households Proportional to Village Size — draw_pps_hamilton
text: data frame columns data, containing selected household rows. Villages final allocation zero excluded output entirely.

title: Draw a Sample of Households Proportional to Village Size — draw_pps_hamilton
text: Allocation (step 1 — Hamilton / largest remainder): county, village receives proportional raw allocation \(n_v = N_{county} \times (s_v / S_{county})\), \(s_v\) village household count \(S_{county}\) county total. Allocations floored fractional remainders distributed one unit time villages largest fractional parts county target met. Redistribution (step 2 — minimum floor): Redistribution performed independently within county. Donor villages — whose allocation exceeds effective minimum — sorted descending order surplus drained greedily total deficit sub-minimum villages recovered donor pool exhausted. warning issued county fully satisfy minimum villages. Sampling (step 3): Within village, households drawn via simple random sampling without replacement using random uniform ordering. Villages final allocation zero silently dropped.
